description: Japanese SKILL.md (auto-trigger frontmatter) + references (spec, derivation, illustration style guide & coordinate contract) + scene/reward starter templates + minimal-input example, then validate the whole skill end-to-end with the fictional 天童編 minimal input (new custom scene and reward, render, visual inspection), and clean up. Depends on FEAT-001 (generator, library, CLI must exist). Skill root SK = /Users/makotosaito/bescon/.kiro/skills/bescon-flyer. Sections 'Kiro Skill format', 'SKILL.md content requirements', 'derivation.md content requirements', 'Illustration contract' of /Users/makotosaito/bescon/.agents/tasks/plan.md are authoritative.
steps: Write SK/SKILL.md in Japanese: frontmatter exactly as in plan.md ('name: bescon-flyer', the given description incl. 「ベスコングルメの資料作って」「〇〇編の開催案内」「BCG企画」), body sections 1–7 from plan.md 'SKILL.md content requirements' (概要と出力 / 最小入力 / 導出するもの / 手順 1–10 with the exact CLI commands using workspace-relative paths .kiro/skills/bescon-flyer/scripts/build.js / 既存4枚の更新 / ルール / イラスト スタイルガイド). Include a mandatory PNG visual-inspection checklist (文字の重なり・はみ出し・折返し、曜日、kcal、点線の終点、人物とカロリーバッジの干渉、ご褒美の円). State: spec saved to <workspace>/flyer-specs/BCG企画_〇〇編.json; outputs BCG企画_〇〇編.svg/.png in workspace root with <title> = file base name; keep Japanese out of chat code blocks; verify shops by web search and write 営業時間・定休日は要確認; never embed photos. Keep under 500 lines; link references/ files by relative path.

Write SK/references/spec.md (Japanese): every spec key with 必須/任意/既定値/導出, fit rules and exit codes, illustration reference resolution, '_' comment keys, a fully annotated example pointing at examples/yamadera.json.

Write SK/references/derivation.md (Japanese) per plan.md 'derivation.md content requirements': romaji rules, catchphrase pattern + 4 precedents, theme selection via --themes, METs table + formula + the 4 precedent bases, 持ち物 defaults (season/activity), default timeline construction from start time, notes/caution rules, weekday always computed by the generator, shop-research rule.

Write SK/references/illustration.md (Japanese) per plan.md 'Illustration contract': snippet API ({meta:{id,title,season,trail}, render(ctx)}, ctx.L/ctx.people/ctx.theme/ctx.parts), panel coordinate map (820x330; exercise stage x0–480; hero zone x500–820 with medallion center (690,160) r≈125, steam y0–40, REWARD pill y≈272–294; kcal badge zone x246–610 below y≈300), trail contract (ends x560–570, y160–225), reward contract (centered 0,0, clip r100, ×1.18, full −110..110 fill, dish ≈(−10,12), drink right via parts.beer, end with parts.vignette()), which colors follow the theme (layout only), sips-safe SVG features, seeded rng only, people API (sideFigure poses walk/hike/run/run2, backFigure walk/climb, team jackets #b8432f/#3a5f8f/#3f7a55), lib helper catalogue (one line each), and the style guide (layered depth, atmospheric perspective toward FOG, 7.5頭身 proportions, appetizing reward close-up, seasonal details).

Write SK/illustrations/scenes/_template.js and SK/illustrations/rewards/_template.js: minimal but valid, Japanese-commented starters following the contract (sky gradient + ridge + mist + ground + 3 sideFigures + meta.trail for scene; table + dish + parts.beer + parts.vignette for reward). Make sure `--list` skips ids starting with '_'.

Write SK/examples/minimal-example.json: fictional 蔵王温泉編, 2026-12-12, 10:00, 集合 蔵王温泉バスターミナル, 運動 温泉街の坂道ウォーク, ご褒美 ジンギスカン; `_input` key listing the 6 minimal user inputs, `_derived` key explaining each derived field (area_romaji ZAO ONSEN, subtitle, theme yamabuki + reason, kcal_basis METs 4.3 × hours + formula result, items winter default, timeline from 10:00, notes incl. 要確認, caution true for 12月); illustration scene 'zao', reward 'beef'. Build it into /tmp/bescon-skill-test with --png and visually inspect (weekday must be （土）/SAT).
Build a /tmp spec that points illustration.scene/reward at the two _template.js files; render and inspect to prove the templates work.

End-to-end test (follow SKILL.md literally as if a new agent): minimal input 編名「天童」, 2027-02-13, 10:00, 集合 天童駅, 運動「舞鶴山ハイキング」, ご褒美「天童温泉の将棋の駒そば」. Do a quick web search for the shop (fictional → record 要確認). Derive all fields per references/derivation.md (TENDO; catchphrase like 「舞鶴山を歩いて、整った体で駒そばと乾杯」; unused theme from --themes; METs 6.0 × active hours; winter 持ち物 incl. 雪道で滑りにくい靴・防寒着・手袋; 5-step timeline from 10:00; caution true; notes with 予約 and 営業時間・定休日は要確認). Write /tmp/bescon-skill-test/tendo.json, a NEW scene /tmp/bescon-skill-test/tendo_scene.js (winter 舞鶴山/天童公園: snowy sky, distant snowy ridges with mist, snowFir/sugi woods, a large 将棋の駒 monument on the hill, snowy path, 3 members hiking with poles in team jackets, meta.trail ending at the medallion) and a NEW reward /tmp/bescon-skill-test/tendo_reward.js (soba on a 将棋の駒-shaped wooden board + parts.beer + parts.vignette). Build with --png; read_file the PNG; fix until clean.
Cleanup: rm -rf /tmp/bescon-skill-test/* (keep the dir); run the originals checksum check; confirm the workspace root has no new files (no flyer-specs/ created by tests, no 開催案内*.svg).
acceptance_criteria: SK/SKILL.md frontmatter parses: name == 'bescon-flyer' == directory name, description non-empty, ≤1024 chars, contains 「ベスコングルメの資料作って」「〇〇編の開催案内」「BCG企画」; body < 500 lines and in Japanese

SKILL.md documents minimal required input (編名・開催日・集合時刻・集合場所・運動内容・ご褒美の食事), optional inputs with defaults, derivations, step-by-step procedure incl. mandatory PNG visual inspection, output naming + <title>, tofu/code-block rule, shop web-search + 要確認 rule, no-photo rule, style guide
references/{spec,derivation,illustration}.md exist and match the implemented generator behaviour (keys, defaults, exit codes, coordinates)
minimal-example.json and the _template-based spec build with exit 0 and render cleanly (visually inspected)

/tmp/bescon-skill-test is empty at the end; originals.sha256 check all OK
